title: Provider Entry
description: One entry in the provider registry (src/commands/providers.ts), extended with its declared authentication method. The registry stays the single source of truth: adding a provider or changing how it authenticates is a registry edit, not a code branch. No entry ever carries a credential value.

name.description: Stable id used as the provider name, e.g. deepseek.

baseUrl.description: API base URL, before the chat/models path. Absent for local runtimes configured elsewhere.

models.description: Curated fallback ids, used only when the live models fetch fails.

remoteCapable.description: Whether the method can be completed by an operator holding only a phone. True for device-code and none; false for api-key and oauth-pkce-loopback, which need the machine. Decides what a transport may offer.

envKey.description: Environment variable carrying the Bearer key, for api-key entries. Names the variable; never holds the value.

clientId.description: Public client identifier. Not a secret; the device grant is defined for public clients.

termsNote.description: Why this entry declares the methods it does, when a vendor restricts third-party clients. Makes the compliance boundary reviewable in the data rather than only in prose.
